benefits.text: A multi-use blush palette that can be used for contouring and highlighting. Soft, subtle layers of color blend together for flushed cheeks. The perfect combination of cream and powder textures helps improve adherence and color wear, with a soft, smooth finish for cheeks that look full of life. You can customise and mix the two shades to create your own signature look.

howToUse.text: Use both shades together to create light and dark accents that suit your skin and face.

safety.text:
For external use on the cheeks only; avoid use on scratched or irritated skin
Discontinue use if any unusual signs appear, and keep out of reach of children.

texture.text: Soft, smooth cream + fine powder blush.

positioning.text: A 2-pan blush combining cream and powder for a soft, smooth flush with customisable intensity.

sellingPoints.text: 2 textures, cream and powder; soft layers of color blend together; boosts adherence and color wear.

finish.text: Soft matte / natural flush / soft and smooth.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say its contouring/highlighting replaces dedicated products. This is a multi-use cheek palette for a light makeup effect.
